findings.finding: The exchange route violates the within-footprint requirement
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Six panels, separate boards and four beams now store inside the frame. Prescribed large-part paths are checked continuously. Manual preference, small-part transfers, human access and positive retention remain open.

findings.finding: Five deck clamping stations break the MDF support edge
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Unsupported MDF sub-bed and its five broken-edge seats are absent. New 20 mm ties carry 15 mm washers with nominal full bearing; slot/preload qualification remains BED04.

findings.finding: The required full-face surfacing operation is outside the tool envelope
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: No unreachable full sub-bed surfacing is specified. Six spoilboard faces lie inside nominal center travel. Final cutter/guard clearance, seat map and repeat-installation accuracy remain unqualified.

findings.finding: The selected M5 joint still loads the extrusion lips under tightening
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Actual T-slot lips and M5 nuts still carry preload. No unsupported torque, uplift or creep rating is issued.

findings.finding: Four drawdown weldnuts have an unclosed physical attachment detail
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Gap-bridging weldnuts replaced by bearing plates, attached bosses and real compression sleeves. Weld strength, local tube-wall loads and tightening method still need qualification.

findings.finding: Locator fits and receiver engagement are not manufacturing-defined
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Round/relieved locator geometry is defined. Front seats are removable with clearance bolts; no automatic return-to-zero is claimed. Map seats and re-probe; qualify repeatability and fits.

findings.finding: Nominal strip-width tolerance is not absorbed solely at free edges
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: 10 x 5.5 mm tie slots provide +/-2.25 mm nominal lateral M5-shank movement. Actual accumulated profile tolerances must fit that allowance.

findings.finding: The modeled final stack omits the instructed1 mm skim
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Finished spoilboards are 18 mm, explicitly skimmed 1 mm from rough 19 mm stock. The STEP now represents that finished stack.

findings.finding: The stiffness screen is not an upper bound on full machine compliance
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Legacy strength screen is not used as whole-machine evidence. Tool, gantry, frame, seats, joints and feet require a combined load/deflection analysis.

findings.finding: TEK restraint and pull-through are not qualified for the actual assembly
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: MDF-to-steel TEK restraint is absent from the new bed. Independent cabinet TEK fasteners are a separate detail; new panel/beam joints still need qualification.

findings.finding: The sling and support system is outside the collision and load analysis
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: No assumed owner winch, sling or external parking. Manual components have nominal masses and routes. Handling preference, reach and restraint remain unqualified.

findings.finding: Sampled positive-volume checks do not certify tolerance or continuous clearance
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: New continuous geometric checks cover ordered panel, board and beam paths with previously stored parts. They exclude fingers, tolerance stack, small-part transfers and retention; nine router poses are still discrete samples.

findings.finding: Lifting mass has inconsistent estimation bases
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Nominal panel mass ~3.866 kg and beam mass ~5.060 kg use modeled solids and stated densities. Weigh finished assemblies; real hardware, welds and residue are not validated by those estimates.

findings.finding: Frame and pan support assumptions do not define a released structural rating
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Frame, feet, pan and reservoir support/load stability have no released structural rating.

findings.finding: Adapter front counter-slots are rotated 90 degrees in the delivered DXF
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Both adapter front recesses have matching vertical STEP/DXF orientation; reconstructed void comparison passes. The physical purchased mating interface remains guarded.

findings.finding: Exported torch-clamp halves do not contain their claimed fastening features
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Invalid legacy torch-clamp solids are excluded from Rev G and guarded in source. A real measured torch clamp still needs design.

findings.finding: Plasma setup CAD has no installed plasma cutting tool
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: No installed, dimensioned plasma torch, floating head or breakaway. The second assembly is named BED_STORED and is not an operational plasma setup.

findings.finding: The 22 stored motion clashes come from an unraised cap fixture
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Motion fixture uses the actual raised rail-cap datum; the earlier22 clashes were fixture errors. Targeted and full-machine pose results are reported separately.

findings.finding: Z output attachment is provisional and its slot/thread claims are not sufficient to choose hardware
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Supplier70 mm spacing applies to smaller5 mm holes; thread, longitudinal pitch and output height are unconfirmed. Removed guessedM6 screws; adapter production export is guarded.

findings.finding: HMS/HGR/Z mounting and power-off Z retention are still unresolved
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: HMS/HGR/Z mounting, actual motor/driver requirements and power-loss Z retention are unresolved.

findings.finding: Travel and service checks omit operational cutters, leads and dual-Y skew
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Operational cutters, torch geometry, cable/lead bends, workholding and independent dual-Y skew still need integrated checks.

findings.finding: Selected water hardware and its complete service route are missing from the CAD
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Selected valve, pump, fittings and complete hoses/service route are not fully modeled. The CAD pan/tank does not imply an operational automatic water system.

findings.finding: Cabinet stringers claim predrilled clearance holes but export as plain tubes
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Cabinet stringers now contain the specified6 mm bores through both walls; unsupported screw/stringer collision allowances removed.

findings.finding: Drip-cap flat pattern does not define the instructed folded part
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Undefined folded cap replaced by actual sloped roof, separate welded lip, four cage tabs and M5 fasteners. Sampled shield service path checked against the frame subset; actual cabinet door still unknown.

findings.finding: Reservoir lid removal has no demonstrated route past the rear brace
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: A fully demonstrated reservoir lid removal route past the rear brace is still absent. Trays on the lid must be emptied for service.

findings.finding: Drained-level guard has only 0.672 mm clearance to the pan floor
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Drained-level guard moved upward. Minimum nominal clearance including slot play is10.3713 mm, with8 mm as-built requirement. Wet calibration remains open.

findings.finding: Pan guards are outside center travel but very close to its right edge
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Right pan guards remain close to maximum nominal tool center. Actual cutting tool/torch and useful plasma area need verification.

findings.finding: Whole-frame rigidity and support stability remain unverified
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Full frame stiffness, fastening, foot reactions, leveling and overturning are not qualified.

findings.finding: Cabinet access is plausible but an enclosure block does not prove service clearance
findings.evidence_or_remaining_action: Stored parts occupy the cabinet access zone: reinstall the bed to empty racks before cabinet service. Actual enclosure door, thermal layout, glands and hose separation remain open.
